title: Responsible AI, Safety, Privacy, and Security
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Responsible AI, Safety, Privacy, and Security and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 16: Responsible AI, Safety, Privacy, and Security. It lists 11 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 16 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 11 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. Responsible AI is a lifecycle practice. Assess foreseeable harms, data handling, security boundaries, transparency needs, and routes for human accountability. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
